verdict.rationale: Formant's docs describe the Python Cloud SDK as the main programmatic way for data scientists to query telemetry through the query API. The guide is explicitly titled data export, which covers querying and exporting for offline analysis. Custom SQL queries are also documented within Formant Analytics. Missing for 10: SQL is documented only in the context of building dashboards rather than as a direct export path, export formats and bulk-export details are unevidenced, no public OpenAPI spec was found (the probe returned 404s), and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
